prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Discover Your Perfect Desktop Companion", "Answer 3 quick questions about your daily routine to match with an ideal pet partner.", "Select Companion Trait Focus"]
1: ["You Are All Set!", "Your companion is ready to roam your desktop. Use system tray shortcuts anytime to summon or manage your pet."]
2: ["Express Custom Pet Studio", "Review visual style parameters before final background generation begins.", "Clear front-facing lighting produces the crispest desktop render."]
3: ["Link Account to Secure Your Companion", "Save your newly generated desktop pet to your cloud account to prevent progress resets.", "Link & Complete Setup"]
4: ["Bringing Your Companion to Life", "Synthesizing pet behaviors and calibrating desktop physics...", "Desktop Asset Generation"]
5: ["How Would You Like to Meet Your Pet?", "Choose a quick ready-to-play companion or create a custom pet from photos."]
6: ["For best results: use well-lit photos with clear subject framing and neutral backgrounds.", "Photo Checklist: Bright Lighting | Single Subject | Clear Eyes"]
7: ["Your Companion Has Arrived!", "Find your pet roaming your desktop. Right-click the system tray icon to hide, customize, or interact at any time.", "Press Ctrl+Shift+P to instantly toggle pet visibility on screen."]
8: ["Signing in links your desktop pet ID to your cloud profile, guarding against data loss.", "Automatic Cloud Profile Guard Active"]
9: ["Pet Active on Desktop"]

verdicts.problem: asks for personal information about the user
